solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One unused to early retirement?

parts.note: retirement here is going to bed, not leaving work: someone who never turns in early and stays up into the small hours

explanation.walkthrough: 'Early retirement' suggests stopping work before pension age; here it means going to bed early.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who habitually stays up late is called by this bird-based nickname, the opposite of an early bird.

clue.text: Historic city boundary encloses nobleman briefly

indicators.note: encloses says one piece goes round another, so the fence surrounds the shortened peer

parts.note: a fence is a boundary round a field or garden

indicators.note: briefly says the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: a lord is a nobleman

explanation.surface: A walled old city whose boundary takes in a nobleman's estate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' docks one letter from the peer. 'Historic' is part of the definition, not an 'old' signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tuscan capital, cradle of the Renaissance, is a city rich in history.

clue.text: Bring down constant speed

parts.note: C is the standard symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light
to hasten is to speed up or hurry

explanation.surface: An instruction to reduce a steady velocity.
explanation.definitionFit: To humble or subdue someone, taking them down a peg, is a synonym of the clue's phrase.

clue.text: Crosses border somewhat to the north, to keep occupying

indicators.note: to the north says the hidden letters are read backwards
somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Troops cross a frontier heading north to keep territory under occupation.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'to the north' means read upwards: the hidden run SSESBO read from the bottom gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To preoccupy the mind continually is to stay lodged in someone's thoughts, constantly filling them.

clue.text: Almost graceless old wrangler

indicators.note: almost says the word falls one letter short, losing its last

parts.note: gauche means awkward and graceless

explanation.surface: An awkward veteran cowboy who lacks charm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrangler' is a cowboy who handles horses, not someone who argues.
explanation.definitionFit: A South American cowboy is a herdsman, just as a wrangler tends horses or cattle.

clue.text: Rat's special hurtful article laid into old city

parts.note: ill can mean harmful or hurtful, as in ill effects

indicators.note: laid into says one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: Thebes was an ancient city of Egypt and of Greece
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A rodent's nasty special article lodged in an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rat's' is Rat is: to rat is to inform, and the 's is a link. AN goes into THEBES to give THEBEANS.
explanation.definitionFit: To rat on someone is to reveal secrets, the same as divulging information that should stay hidden.

clue.text: Society who can't abide wavering opposition leaders

indicators.note: wavering suggests the letters are unsteady and shift around

explanation.surface: A group of people who cannot tolerate indecision.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the senior opposition MPs form a team mirroring the government's ministers.
explanation.definitionFit: The official opposition's frontbench spokespeople, each shadowing a minister, are the leading opponents of the government.

clue.text: Most of deposition I transfer legally covers everything for electronics area

indicators.note: most of says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: silt is a deposit of sediment

indicators.note: covers means surrounds, so one piece goes round another

parts.note: to convey property is to transfer it by deed
all means everything

explanation.surface: A legal document about property transfer, read in an electronics context.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deposition' sounds like legal testimony but means sediment.
explanation.definitionFit: The Santa Clara valley in California is the heart of the computer and microchip industry.

clue.text: Means to turn right in panic

parts.note: a lathe is a machine for turning wood or metal

explanation.surface: How to turn right when you are in a state of alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' is the woodworker's sense, shaping on a rotating spindle.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a lather is an idiom for being agitated or flustered, a state of fluster and alarm.

clue.text: Military Cross received by hard-line, versatile unit?

indicators.note: received by says the medal is taken inside the other letters

parts.note: steel is a byword for hardness
MC is the abbreviation for the Military Cross gallantry medal

explanation.surface: A soldier who takes a hard line wins the Military Cross and proves an adaptable member of the unit.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology, an undifferentiated cell can develop into many types, making it an all-purpose building block of the body.

clue.text: English fleet wanting shelter for amphibian

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind

explanation.surface: An English navy with no harbour to hide in.
explanation.walkthrough: FLEET minus LEE leaves FT.
explanation.definitionFit: A young newt is called by this old dialect name, and newts are amphibians.

clue.text: Carefully protect soft sound amid racket

indicators.note: amid says one piece sits in the middle of another

parts.note: a racket is a scam or con
a coo is the soft sound a dove makes

explanation.surface: Keeping a quiet sound safe in the middle of a din.
explanation.walkthrough: 'racket' looks like noise, which suits the surface, but it is a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrap someone in protective comfort is to shelter them as a silkworm's casing does.

clue.text: Escape as soon as knight enters lodge

indicators.note: enters says the piece goes inside the others

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a keyboard
N is the chess notation for a knight
once can mean as soon as, as in once you arrive

explanation.surface: A prisoner flees the moment a knight comes into the lodge.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle oneself snugly in a place is to establish or install, here used as a verb.

clue.text: Rattan pruned in bog

indicators.note: pruned says the word is trimmed, its last letter cut off

parts.note: rattan is a kind of cane

explanation.surface: Cutting back rattan that grows in marshland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bog' is slang for a toilet, not marshland.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal words for a toilet, the American slang and the British slang.

clue.text: Length must overcome any resistance in bolt cutter

indicators.note: must overcome says one letter beats and takes the place of the other
any says the swap applies to every instance, not just one

parts.note: to scarper is to bolt or run away
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Bolt cutters need length to beat any resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bolt cutter' reads as a tool, but 'bolt' is the verb, and both Rs of SCARPER become Ls.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeon's small, very sharp knife is a cutting instrument.

clue.text: What's oddly missed in quip taken the wrong way?

definitions.text: What's oddly missed in quip taken the wrong way?

indicators.note: taken the wrong way says the surviving letters are read backwards
the odd-numbered letters are left out, so only the even ones survive

explanation.surface: What a listener misses when a witticism is misunderstood.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the odd letters of 'in quip' leaves NUP; 'taken the wrong way' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Wordplay on a double meaning is exactly what gets missed when a joke is taken in its other sense.

clue.text: Sweet and flowing in poetic source

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside another

parts.note: font is a poetic word for a fountain or spring

indicators.note: flowing suggests the letters run into a new order

explanation.surface: Something sweet and liquid springs from a poet's fountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flowing' rearranges the word 'and' into DAN. 'poetic source' is a fountain, not a writer's inspiration.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft sugar paste used for icing and confectionery is a kind of sweet.

clue.text: Nothing to lie in, dozing maybe achieved without effort

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
a lie-in is perhaps a doze in bed until late: nap and late

explanation.surface: Having nothing to do but sleep in is an easy life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' joins the pieces: O, then NAP for dozing and LATE for the lie-in.
explanation.definitionFit: Something handed over on a plate is gained with no work, an idiom for getting it easily.

clue.text: Miserable, sad and moody way the world ends?

indicators.note: miserable suggests the letters are in a wretched, disordered state

explanation.surface: A gloomy, sullen picture of the apocalypse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Miserable' looks like part of the mood but signals rearranging SAD and MOODY.
explanation.definitionFit: The Last Judgement, the end of all things, is the day the world ends.

clue.text: Lack of interest in economic expansion is possible indication of overdraft

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: a boom is a period of economic expansion
being in the red means an overdrawn bank account

explanation.surface: Indifference to economic growth may signal that one is overdrawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interest' sounds financial, matching the surface, but the definition is about being uninterested.
explanation.definitionFit: Weariness from having nothing engaging to do is the absence of any interest.

clue.text: Keeping hospital place, a conscious person who was protected from fire

definitions.text: person who was protected from fire

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: an is the form of the indefinite article
a bed is a place in a hospital
the ego is the conscious self

explanation.surface: A self-aware patient keeps a hospital bed.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Book of Daniel, Shadrach, Meshach and this man survived Nebuchadnezzar's furnace. 'Keeping' is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: He was one of three young Jews thrown into a fiery furnace who walked out unharmed.

clue.text: Apply to undo suffrage?

parts.note: de- is a prefix meaning undo or reverse
suffrage is the right to vote, a vote

explanation.surface: A question whether to campaign to remove the right to vote.
explanation.definitionFit: To dedicate time or effort to something is to give or commit oneself to it.

clue.text: European arrives to tour New England in rewarding venture

indicators.note: to tour means to go round, so one piece surrounds another

parts.note: arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrives

explanation.surface: A European lands to make a profitable tour of New England.
explanation.definitionFit: A nice little moneymaker is something that brings in income, a profitable sideline.

clue.text: Nut right next to heart of a tree

parts.note: an is the form of the indefinite article

indicators.note: puts the letter in the middle of the following pieces, beside their central letter

parts.note: the oak is a tree

explanation.surface: A nut lying right by the core of a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nut' is not an acorn but an obsessive enthusiast; R goes into ANOAK beside its central O.
explanation.definitionFit: A nut is a fanatic, and this coat-based slang names a geeky obsessive.

clue.text: Company focused on stock performance

parts.note: stock here is a repertoire of plays, not shares: a theatre troupe performing its stock of plays in rotation

explanation.walkthrough: 'stock performance' suggests the stock market; in the theatre a stock company plays a repertoire.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for repertory, the word names a theatre company that stages a rotating stock of plays.

clue.text: Everything lacking variation, perhaps lacking depth

indicators.note: lacking means missing, so the letter is removed

parts.note: something without variety might be called un-diverse

explanation.surface: Something entirely uniform, perhaps without any depth either.
explanation.walkthrough: UNDIVERSE loses its D.
explanation.definitionFit: The cosmos is all that exists, the whole of creation.

clue.text: Stone left in place in the end

indicators.note: in says these pieces go inside another

parts.note: to lay is to place
st is the abbreviation for stone, the weight

explanation.surface: A stone finally left in its spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stone' is the British unit of weight, 14 pounds, abbreviated st.
explanation.definitionFit: Finally, as the last point, means coming at the close of a list.

clue.text: Tory chatter on changes with conflicting effect?

indicators.note: changes says the letters are rearranged into something new

explanation.surface: Conservative gossip continues as policy shifts, with opposite results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tory' is a member of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase introduces a contradiction, saying the opposite holds, so it has an opposing force.
